name: UAMS Initiative for Maximizing Student Development (IMSD)
product_description: A University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences programme that supports underrepresented biomedical Ph.D. trainees through peer mentoring, transition programming, competency-based portfolio management, role-model seminars, and active-learning coursework.
